description: Search saved Reddit posts by keyword, subreddit, tag, author, content type, read status, or date range. Returns all matching results ranked by relevance — no arbitrary limit.

author.description: Filter by Reddit username (without u/ prefix)

limit.description: Max results to return (omit to return all matches)

query.description: Search keywords (matches title, body, subreddit, author, notes, labels). Posts are scored across multiple fields and ranked by relevance.

sort_by.description: Sort order (default: relevance when query is present, newest otherwise)

subreddit.description: Filter by subreddit name (without r/ prefix)

name: search_posts
